description:
The FinancialCalcApp project is open in Android Studio. The app contains three financial calculation classes with zero test coverage:

- LoanCalculator: calculates monthly payments, total interest, remaining balance, and loan eligibility
- InvestmentAnalyzer: calculates ROI, CAGR, compound interest, Sharpe ratio, and volatility
- BudgetPlanner: calculates savings rates, emergency funds, budget allocations, and months-to-goal

The project already has JUnit 4.13.2 and Mockito 5.8.0 in testImplementation. Your task is to write comprehensive unit tests targeting at least 80% of the logic in these three classes:

1. Create test files in app/src/test/java/com/example/financialcalc/
2. Write at least 15 @Test methods total across the three classes
3. Test normal operation (expected results match), edge cases (zero values, maximum values), and error cases (negative inputs, invalid parameters that should throw exceptions)
4. All tests must pass when running ./gradlew test

Login credentials: user 'ga', password 'password123'.

Ensure the project compiles and all written tests pass.
